shittified.title: Added ads to existing Prime Video plans
shittified.description: Ads were introduced to existing Prime Video plans, with a more expensive plan introduced that removes the ads. See additional links for the ACCC filings for unfair contract terms.

shittified.title: Removed basic plan in place of standard
shittified.description: With the removal of the $12.99 basic plan, in order to get the same features users are pushed to the standard $20.99 plan or deal with ads ontop of paying $9.99 a month. The addition of the cheaper ads plan was a decent option for those who wanted to pay less, but the removal of the basic plan has turned it into enshitification.
